description: For uniform permutations, the covariance of the number of fixed points with second-largest cycle length is strictly positive at sizes 2 through 5, strictly negative thereafter, and tends to minus the classical second-ranked normalized cycle mean.
limitations: Uniform permutations only; tie ranks counted individually and missing second cycle assigned zero.
Historical-priority uncertainty remains because Shepp and Lloyd proved the general ranked-cycle insertion identity.
The Shepp-Lloyd constant is a classical value and is not independently re-evaluated here.
scientific_integrity: Fully finite sign theorem proved using cycle-index counting, ranked-cycle insertion, and two disjoint constructive families. The nonzero asymptotic covariance uses cited classical second-cycle limit theory and a published equal-cycle bound. Independent validation and external audit have not occurred.
title: A sharp fixed-point covariance reversal for the second-largest cycle of a random permutation
